column3: With respect to the Marriott Albuquerque Mortgage Loan (6.6%), if there is a proposed transfer of the Mortgaged Property or an ownership interest in the borrower to a Competitor (as defined below), the franchisor has a ROFR to purchase the hotel or the ownership interest on the same terms. “Competitor” means any person that owns, has an interest in, or is an affiliate, principal or director of a person that owns or has an interest in a brand that is comprised of at least (i) 10 Luxury Hotels, (ii) 20 Full-Service Hotels or (iii) 50 Limited-Service Hotels; "Luxury Hotels" means hotels in a brand that has a system average daily rate of more than $180 and an average number of rooms per location of more than 100; "Full-Service Hotels" means hotels that typically offer three meals per day and have an average of at least 3,000 square feet of meeting space per hotel in the hotel brand; and "Limited-Service Hotels" means hotels that are neither Luxury Hotels nor Full Service Hotels. A person is not a Competitor if such person has an interest in such brand merely as a franchisee or as a mere passive investor that has no control or influence over the business decisions concerning the brand at issue, such as limited partners in a partnership or as a non-controlling mere stockholder in a corporation.
